All Goals

Weekly Routine

Muscle Gain

Push/Pull/Legs with an upper–lower volume day uses each muscle group 2× per week — the minimum effective frequency for hypertrophy. The split front-loads compound movements for mechanical tension, then finishes with isolation work for metabolic stress. Rest days are placed after the leg day and at the end of the week to allow recovery on the highest-volume sessions.

5-Day Schedule

Day 1 Push — Chest & Triceps
  1. 1 Barbell Bench Press
  2. 2 Incline Dumbbell Press
  3. 3 Cable Crossover
  4. 4 Barbell Overhead Press
  5. 5 Cable Triceps Pushdown
Day 2 Pull — Back & Biceps
  1. 1 Barbell Bent-Over Row
  2. 2 Lat Pulldown
  3. 3 Seated Cable Row
  4. 4 Cable Face Pull
  5. 5 Barbell Curl
Day 3 Legs — Quads, Hamstrings & Glutes
  1. 1 Barbell Back Squat
  2. 2 Romanian Deadlift
  3. 3 Leg Press
  4. 4 Leg Curl (Machine)
  5. 5 Standing Calf Raise
Day 4 Upper — Chest, Back & Shoulders (Volume)
  1. 1 Barbell Incline Bench Press
  2. 2 Pull-Up
  3. 3 Dumbbell Shoulder Press
  4. 4 Dumbbell Hammer Curl
  5. 5 Skull Crusher
Day 5 Lower — Glutes & Hamstrings (Volume)
  1. 1 Hack Squat
  2. 2 Barbell Glute Bridge
  3. 3 Leg Extension
  4. 4 Bulgarian Split Squat
  5. 5 Barbell Good Morning
